title: Generative / large reconstruction models for heads (2024-2026)

queue.claim: Hunyuan3D 2.x licence (Tencent Hunyuan 3D Community License) excludes the EU, UK and South Korea and has a monthly-active-user cap; TRELLIS code and weights are MIT (with non-commercial CUDA dependencies). The tool's default backend choice depends on these terms.

queue.claim: No generic image-to-3D generator (Hunyuan3D, TRELLIS, Rodin, Tripo, Meshy) or head model (PanoHead, Arc2Avatar, FaceLift) has published NoW or REALY millimetre error on real faces. The author estimates 2-4 mm frontal, 3-8 mm nose and chin, and 5-15 mm occiput and ears, and uses these figures to set the generator-term sigmas (Table 5).

queue.claim: TRELLIS.2 (late 2025) has about 4B parameters, an 'O-Voxel' latent, resolution up to 1536^3, PBR output and an MIT licence. Hunyuan3D 2.5/3.0 are hosted only and claim up to 1536^3.

queue.claim: EG3D volume-renders its tri-plane (3x256^2x32 channels) at 128^2 and super-resolves in 2D to 512^2, so fine detail at 512^2 is not in the 3D density. PanoHead uses a tri-grid of depth 3 trained on FFHQ-F. SphereHead uses spherical tri-planes to suppress back-of-head faces.
